title: Parkingeye Ltd v Velindre University NHS Trust & Cardiff and Vale University Health Board
description: The contracting authorities awarded a £10-20 million 5-year car park management services contract to National Parking Control Group (NPCG) over incumbent provider Parkingeye Ltd, which scored 68% against NPCG's 84%. Parkingeye alleged transparency failure in the tender notice (£100,000 stated value), post-commencement evaluation methodology changes, and inconsistent treatment of bidders during clarification exchanges. The court applied the new statutory test for lifting automatic suspension under section 101 of the Procurement Act 2023 and refused to lift the suspension, finding the balance of public interest favoured allowing Parkingeye's challenge to proceed.
